bio: Situated in a majestic mountain setting just a few kilometres from the elegant Kranjska Gora ski resort, Triangel is the perfect place to stay and to enjoy a pleasant dinner, with a delightful outdoor terrace that is a must in summer. The cuisine has something for everyone, with a menu offering a combination of modern and traditional dishes. Dishes not to missed include the ričet (a typical Slovenian barley soup with Carniolan sausage), the delicious veal loin with shallot sauce, and perfectly cooked steak. The tasting menus are a convenient option at lunchtime, while the wine list includes a selection of top-quality local and international labels....
